citations.assessment: The digital Mekhilta places the exchange on Exodus 18:15 in Amalek 4:3. It names Yehudah of Kefar Akko and Rabban Gamliel.
The internal Chalafta notice is the exact named cross-reference. Its mention of a son Shimon does not establish the antecedent of the brief separate statement here.
The exact named internal entry is distinct from the Mekhilta’s wording. Preserve the cross-reference without an identity equation.
